faqs.q: What is the difference between the neuromodulators you offer?
faqs.a: All four - Botox, Dysport, Jeuveau and Daxxify - use botulinum toxin type A, but vary in formulation, onset and duration. The right brand is selected for your facial structure at your appointment.

faqs.q: How long do dermal fillers last?
faqs.a: Filler results typically last anywhere from 6 to 18 months, depending on the product and area treated.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: You can secure an appointment by calling us directly at 561-537-9302 - or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up by email.
